title: React Js Store Boundary Refactor
description: Refactor semio/react to be a pure consumer of semio/js stores (promise + subscribe only). Move command wire construction, LiveKitRoot reads, and kitEventAffects usage from react into semio/js. Internal RxJS stays in KitStore; KitStoreClient.subscribe delivers typed kit events.
closeSummary: JS: piecePatchToWireCommands, connectionPatchToWireCommands, connectionDiffWireKeyForDataKey; expanded buildSchemaEntityChangeCommands (Piece/Connection); resolveDesignIdForPieceOrConnection; kitStoreClientUpdatePiece/Connection; kitStoreClientAddChildByKind/RemoveChildByKind/AddPiece/RemovePiece/AddConnection; tag orderIndex in oneChangeTagCommandForField. React: useKitAdd/Remove + piece/connection hooks use these; live-read hooks use KitStoreClient read* promises only; embedded test client stubs read*. Removed rxjs+zod deps from @semio/react. Tests: js +1 describe (4 tests), react stub surface test. Ran npm run build/test @semio/js, @semio/react, depcruise:layers (pass).
